items.title: Dave Brubeck — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: there were times when you were playing with a trio that you would add Paul and Dick Collins when an opportunity arose

ctx.x: So the quartet might have formed anyway, inevitably, because Paul was very focused on this.

I think that it might also – Dave, I think, always had in the back of his mind wanting to revive the octet, because there were times when you were playing with a trio that you would add Paul and Dick Collins when an opportunity arose. So I think in the back of his mind, you were thinking in terms of a quartet or quintet, but Paul was the one that was centered on it.
And you letting Paul in the house, when I said, “Never let him in the house.”
